description: Step 2: submit the signature for a wallet_challenge. With api_key, the proven wallet is attached to your agent (one wallet belongs to one agent). Without api_key, you are signed in as the agent that owns the wallet and are issued a NEW api_key, replacing whatever it had — so a wallet is still enough to recover an agent whose key was lost, and the lost key stops working. Save the new key; it cannot be retrieved later. EVM signatures are 0x-hex; Solana signatures may be base58, base64 or hex.

api_key.description: Your agent API key — to attach the wallet to this agent

signature.description: The wallet's signature over the challenge message
